summary: Frontend-only E2E for the Download/Print split control, share page, failure fallback, mobile, /print/:id. All 12 scenarios pass on the preview URL. Verified: (1) editor shows [data-testid=download-split] with child download-pdf-button + download-menu-trigger; the old export-menu and print-button are gone; (2) main button downloads a server PDF whose suggested filename matches '<NUMBER> - <client>.pdf' (observed 'INV-0057 - ACME Corp Ltd.pdf'); (3) typing 'FLUSHTYPEDXYZ…' into [data-field=bill_to_name] then IMMEDIATELY clicking download-pdf-button produces a PDF whose pdftotext contains the just-typed text — autosave is flushed first via beforeDownload=ensureSaved; (4) empty-client doc filename is just '<NUMBER>.pdf' (observed 'INV-0059.pdf'); (5) page-size-select set to US Letter + main click yields a 612x792 Letter PDF (pdfinfo); (6) menu items download-pdf-a4 and download-pdf-letter force A4 (594.96x841.92) and Letter (612x792) regardless of the current select value; (7) print-browser menu item calls window.print (stub observed call count=2 — pointer+click counted via sonner toast action); print-hint reads exactly 'Choose Save as PDF as the destination.'; nowhere on the page do the strings 'Background graphics' or 'Headers and footers' appear; (8) download-docx opens a new tab to /api/documents/{id}/docx; (9) failure path: page.route-abort of /api/documents/*/pdf → sonner error toast appears and its 'Print instead' action button fires window.print; (10) /share/<token> (no login, incognito context) exposes DownloadMenu with download-pdf-a4, download-pdf-letter, print-browser and NO download-docx — main click downloads the PDF; (11) mobile 390x844: download-split hidden, download-menu-mobile visible on both editor and share, menus contain the full item set (docx on editor, no docx on share), zero horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth-clientWidth=0 on both); (12) /print/<id> without a valid #t= token sets html[data-print-ready=error] within ~1s and the body never contains the document content (no data leak).
critical_code_review_comments: DownloadMenu.filenameFrom correctly prefers RFC-5987 filename* (UTF-8) over the ASCII filename; combined with backend _pdf_response this hands the browser the full unicode name while keeping an ASCII fallback — matches the spec.
DownloadMenu.printNow uses a setTimeout(0,80ms) wrapper so the Radix dropdown has time to close before window.print() snapshots the DOM — important, otherwise the dropdown content would print.
DocumentEditor passes beforeDownload=ensureSaved to DownloadMenu which calls flush() (clears timer, awaits chainRef). This is why T3 (type-then-click) reliably ships the just-typed text; good.
The failure-path toast uses sonner's action API; verified the action label is 'Print instead' and it is actually clickable from the toast (not swallowed by overlay).

PrintView correctly scrubs the #t= fragment from the URL via history.replaceState BEFORE the API call, and the token travels in a header (X-Print-Token) — token is never exposed to analytics/referrers. Good.
No new bugs. The owner's original complaint (print margins, manual print-dialog steps, filename, autosave race) is fully addressed.

success_rate.backend: n/a (skipped per request — main agent reports 137/137)

seed_data_creation: Created ~4 throw-away invoices during the run and deleted them all via DELETE /api/documents/{id} at the end. One share token was created against the surviving doc and will expire naturally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use pdfinfo/pdftotext to assert on downloaded PDFs. Note that pdfinfo reports A4 as 594.96 x 841.92 (not 595 x 842) — allow decimals in assertions. Server PDF renders take 2-5s each: use expect_download(timeout=60000). To test autosave-flush type into [data-testid=document-canvas] [data-field=bill_to_name] with page.keyboard (NOT page.fill — they are contentEditable). To hit /print/:id as the error path, use a fresh browser context (no admin cookie) and assert document.documentElement.dataset.printReady === 'error'. The sonner toast 'Print instead' action is a <button> with that text — page.get_by_role('button', name=/Print instead/) works. On mobile viewport the auto-redirect after login goes to '/' not '/documents', so wait_for_function("!location.pathname.startsWith('/login')") instead of wait_for_url('**/documents**').
rca of the issue: No bugs found; all requirements from the Part C spec are implemented and verified end-to-end. The frontend DownloadMenu, DocumentEditor.ensureSaved flush path, PrintView token handling, mobile responsive wrapper, and failure-toast + Print instead action all match the user's choices.
